title: am / is / are
lesson:
I → am (I'm)
he / she / it → is (he's, she's, it's)
we / you / they → are (we're, you're, they're)

• I am a student.
(Men talabaman.)
• She is at home.
(U uyda.)
• They are my friends.
(Ular mening do'stlarim.)

Negative (inkor):
I'm not · he/she/it isn't · we/you/they aren't

• I'm not hungry.
(Men och emasman.)
• It isn't cold today.
(Bugun sovuq emas.)
• We aren't late.
(Biz kechikmadik / kech emasmiz.)

q.q: My sister and I ___ good swimmers.
Tom ___ a teacher. He's a doctor. (negative)

q.uz: Men ochman. Keling, biror narsa yeymiz.

q.q: My parents ___ at work now. They're at home. (negative)
q.uz: Ota-onam hozir ishda emas. Ular uyda.

q.q: Write the short form: she is → ___

tip: O'zbek tilida "men talabaman" deymiz — fe'l kerak emas. Ingliz tilida esa gapda albatta fe'l bo'lishi shart, shuning uchun am / is / are qo'shiladi: I am a student.
ex: The shops aren't open on Sunday.
mi: he / she / it bilan doim is.
agree — fe'l, unga am kerak emas.

title: am / is / are (questions)
lesson:
Savolda am / is / are gap boshiga chiqadi:

I am → Am I …?
he/she/it is → Is he/she/it …?
we/you/they are → Are we/you/they …?

• Are you a student?
(Siz talabamisiz?)
• Is it cold outside?
(Tashqarida sovuqmi?)
• Where is my phone?
(Telefonim qayerda?)

Short answers (qisqa javoblar):
Yes, I am. · No, I'm not.
Yes, it is. · No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. · No, they aren't.

• Are you tired? — Yes, I am.
(Charchadingizmi? — Ha.)

q.w: Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. (I'm emas!)

q.q: Is it cold today? — No, it ___.
q.w: Inkor qisqa javob: No, it isn't.

tip: O'zbekchada savolni "-mi" qo'shimchasi bilan yasaymiz: "Siz talabamisiz?". Inglizchada esa am / is / are gap boshiga chiqadi: You are → Are you …?
ex: Is it far from here? — No, it isn't.
Are they your friends? — Yes, they are.

title: I am doing (present continuous)
lesson:
am / is / are + verb-ing — hozir, ayni shu paytda bo'layotgan ish.

I am working.
(Men ishlayapman.)
She is reading a book.
(U kitob o'qiyapti.)
They are playing football.
(Ular futbol o'ynashyapti.)

Negative (inkor):
I'm not working · she isn't reading · they aren't playing

Spelling (yozilishi):
come → coming (e tushadi)
run → running, sit → sitting (undosh ikkilanadi)

• Look! It's raining.
(Qarang! Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
• Please be quiet. I'm studying.
(Iltimos, jim bo'ling. Men o'qiyapman.)

q.q: I ___ TV. You can turn it off. (not / watch)
q.uz: Men televizor ko'rmayapman. O'chirib qo'yishingiz mumkin.
Sara qayerda? — U dush qabul qilyapti.

q.q: The children ___ in the park now. (play)

q.w: "Listen!" — hozir eshitilyapti; somebody = birlik → is singing.

tip: O'zbekchadagi "-yap" (o'qiyapman, ishlayapti) qo'shimchasi inglizchada am/is/are + -ing ga to'g'ri keladi. Ikkalasini ham ishlatish shart: is + reading.

title: are you doing? (present continuous questions)
lesson:
am / is / are + subject + verb-ing?

• Are you working today?
(Bugun ishlayapsizmi?)
• Is it raining?
(Yomg'ir yog'yaptimi?)
• What are you doing?
(Nima qilyapsiz?)
• Why is she crying?
(U nega yig'layapti?)

Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. · Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

q.q: Where are they going? — They ___ to the cinema. (go)
Are you listening to me? — Yes, I ___.
Is Tom working today? — No, he ___.

title: I do / work / like (present simple)
lesson:
Odatiy, doimiy ishlar uchun: I/you/we/they work — he/she/it works

• I work in an office.
(Men ofisda ishlayman.)
• She lives in Tashkent.
(U Toshkentda yashaydi.)
• The sun rises in the east.
(Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.)

Spelling: watch → watches, go → goes, study → studies, have → has

title: I don't ... (present simple negative)
lesson:
I/you/we/they don't (do not) + verb
he/she/it doesn't (does not) + verb

• I don't like coffee.
(Men qahvani yoqtirmayman.)
• She doesn't eat meat.
(U go'sht yemaydi.)

⚠️ doesn't dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: she doesn't play (not plays)

q.q: Make negative: She plays tennis. → She ___ tennis.
Make negative: I know the answer. → I ___ the answer.

title: Do you ...? (present simple questions)
lesson:
Do I/you/we/they + verb? · Does he/she/it + verb?

• Do you play tennis?
(Tennis o'ynaysizmi?)
• Where does she live?
(U qayerda yashaydi?)
• What does this word mean?
(Bu so'z nimani anglatadi?)

Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. · Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

q.q: Do you like football? — Yes, I ___.
Does he work here? — No, he ___.
How often ___ you go to the cinema?

title: I am doing and I do
lesson:
I am doing — hozir, ayni paytda:
• Look! It's raining.
(Qarang! Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

I do — odatda, doimo, har kuni:
• It rains a lot in autumn.
(Kuzda yomg'ir ko'p yog'adi.)

• What are you doing? — I'm reading.
(Nima qilyapsiz? — O'qiyapman.)
• What do you do? — I'm a doctor.
(Kasbingiz nima? — Shifokorman.)

q.uz: Men har kuni ishga piyoda boraman.

q.q: She usually ___ coffee in the morning. (drink)

title: I have ... / I've got ...
lesson:
Ikkalasi ham "bor" ma'nosini beradi:
• I have a car. = I've got a car.
(Mening mashinam bor.)
• She has blue eyes. = She's got blue eyes.
(Uning ko'zlari ko'k.)

Negative: I don't have / I haven't got · she doesn't have / she hasn't got
Questions: Do you have …? / Have you got …?

q.q: Have you got a car? — No, I ___.
Do you have a pen? — Yes, I ___.

title: was / were
lesson:
am/is → was · are → were
I/he/she/it was · we/you/they were

• I was tired yesterday.
(Kecha charchagan edim.)
• They were at home.
(Ular uyda edi.)

Negative: wasn't / weren't · Questions: Was he …? Were you …?

q.q: The film ___ very good. It was boring. (negative)
q.uz: Film unchalik yaxshi emas edi. Zerikarli edi.

q.q: They ___ at school yesterday. They were ill. (negative)
q.uz: Ular kecha maktabda emas edi. Kasal edi.

q.q: Were you at work? — Yes, I ___.

title: worked / got / went (past simple)
lesson:
Regular: work → worked, live → lived, stop → stopped, study → studied
Irregular: go → went, see → saw, buy → bought, get → got, write → wrote

• I watched TV last night.
(Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim.)
• She went to London last year.
(U o'tgan yili Londonga bordi.)

q.q: He ___ his car two years ago. (buy)
q.uz: U mashinasini ikki yil oldin sotib oldi.

q.q: They ___ in Paris for three years. (live)
I ___ up at 7 o'clock this morning.
The lesson ___ at 9 and finished at 10. (start)
q.uz: Dars soat 9 da boshlanib, 10 da tugadi.

title: I didn't ... Did you ...?
lesson:
didn't + verb (asosiy shakl) · Did you + verb?

• I didn't go out.
(Men tashqariga chiqmadim.)
• Did you see Tom?
(Tomni ko'rdingizmi?)

⚠️ did/didn't dan keyin: go (not went), see (not saw)
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

q.q: Did you enjoy the party? — Yes, I ___.
Did they win the game? — No, they ___.
What time ___ the film finish yesterday?
Make negative: He played football. → He ___ football.

title: I was doing (past continuous)
lesson:
was / were + verb-ing — o'tmishda ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ish.

• At 8 o'clock I was having dinner.
(Soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.)
• They were watching TV.
(Ular televizor ko'rayotgan edi.)

Negative: wasn't / weren't + -ing · Questions: Were you working?

q.uz: Kecha soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.
Men kelganimda ular televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
Kecha soat 10 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?

q.q: We ___ to music. We were talking. (not / listen)
q.uz: Biz musiqa tinglamayotgan edik. Gaplashayotgan edik.
U kechki 9 da kitob o'qiyotgan edi.

title: I was doing and I did
lesson:
was doing — davom etayotgan (uzun) ish
did — tugallangan (qisqa) ish

• I was having dinner when the phone rang.
(Telefon jiringlaganda kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.)
• When the phone rang, I answered it.
(Telefon jiringlaganda, men javob berdim.)

q.q: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
q.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edim.

q.q: When the phone rang, I ___ it.
Kate ___ her finger while she was cooking. (cut)
q.uz: Keyt ovqat pishirayotganda barmog'ini kesib oldi.

q.q: I saw Ali when I ___ to work. (walk)
We ___ in the park when it started to rain. (walk)
q.uz: Yomg'ir boshlanganda bog'da sayr qilayotgan edik.

q.q: While I ___ TV, I fell asleep.

q.uz: Men kelganimda ular kechki ovqat yeyayotgan edi.

q.q: Yesterday I ___ up at 7 and ___ breakfast.
q.uz: Kecha soat 7 da turib, nonushta qildim.

title: I have done (present perfect 1)
lesson:
have / has + past participle (3-shakl) — o'tmishdagi ish, natijasi hozir muhim.

• I've lost my keys. (= I can't find them now)
(Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim — hozir topa olmayapman.)
• She has cut her hair.
(U sochini kaltalatibdi.)

Past participle: finish → finished, go → gone, write → written, eat → eaten, see → seen

q.q: I ___ my keys. I can't find them. (lose)
She ___ her hair. It looks nice. (cut)

q.uz: Tom bu yerda yo'q. U uyiga ketgan.

q.q: The bus ___ . We're still waiting. (not / arrive)

title: I've just ... I've already ... I haven't ... yet
lesson:
just — hozirgina: I've just had lunch.
(Hozirgina tushlik qildim.)
already — allaqachon: I've already seen this film.
(Bu filmni allaqachon ko'rganman.)
yet — hali (inkor va savolda, gap oxirida):
• I haven't finished yet.
(Hali tugatmadim.)
• Have you finished yet?
(Tugatdingizmi?)

q.q: I've ___ had lunch, so I'm not hungry.
q.uz: Hozirgina tushlik qildim, shuning uchun och emasman.

q.q: Don't tell me the end! I haven't seen the film ___.
Is Tom here? — No, he's ___ gone. (a minute ago)
q.uz: Tom shu yerdami? — Yo'q, hozirgina ketdi.

q.q: Do you want to read this book? — No, I've ___ read it.
q.uz: Bu kitobni o'qishni xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, allaqachon o'qiganman.

title: Have you ever ...?
lesson:
Hayotingizda biror marta qilganmisiz?

• Have you ever been to Japan?
(Hech Yaponiyada bo'lganmisiz?)
• I've never eaten sushi.
(Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman.)
• She has been to Paris three times.
(U Parijda uch marta bo'lgan.)

been = borib qaytgan · gone = ketgan, hali u yerda

q.q: I've ___ eaten sushi. I want to try it.
q.uz: Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman. Tatib ko'rmoqchiman.

q.q: She has ___ to Paris three times. (be)
Have you ever played golf? — Yes, I ___.
Have you ever lost your passport? — No, I ___.
This is the best film I've ___ seen.
q.uz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.

q.q: Where's Anna? — She has ___ to the shop.

title: How long have you ...?
lesson:
O'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat:
have been / have known / have lived …
have been + -ing (davom etayotgan ish)

• How long have you lived here?
(Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaysiz?)
• I've known her for ten years.
(Uni o'n yildan beri taniyman.)
• It has been raining since morning.
(Ertalabdan beri yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

⚠️ I have known her for … (not I know her for …)

q.uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman.
Biz turmush qurganimizga o'n yil bo'ldi.

q.q: I know Ali. I ___ him for a long time.
q.uz: Men Alini taniyman. Uni ancha vaqtdan beri bilaman.

q.q: They ___ waiting for an hour. (be — present perfect)

title: for / since / ago
lesson:
for + davomiylik: for three years, for two hours
(… davomida / … dan beri)
since + boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2015, since Monday
(… dan beri)
ago = oldin: two years ago
(ikki yil oldin)

• I've lived here since 2015.
(2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman.)
• I met him two years ago.
(U bilan ikki yil oldin tanishganman.)

q.q: She has worked here ___ three years.
q.uz: U bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlaydi.
U bilan ikki yil oldin tanishganman.

q.q: I haven't seen her ___ last summer.

title: I have done and I did
lesson:
have done — vaqt aytilmaydi, natija hozir muhim:
• I've lost my keys.
(Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.)

did — aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, last week, in 2019, ago, when?):
• I lost my keys yesterday.
(Kecha kalitlarimni yo'qotdim.)

⚠️ When did you arrive? (not When have you arrived?)

q.q: I ___ my keys. I can't open the door.
q.uz: Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Eshikni ocha olmayapman.
Biz bir soat oldin kechki ovqat yedik.
Men bu yerda 2010 yildan beri yashayman.

title: is done / was done (passive 1)
lesson:
is/are + past participle · was/were + past participle
Ishni kim qilgani muhim emas, nima qilingani muhim.

• English is spoken in many countries.
(Ingliz tilida ko'p mamlakatlarda gapiriladi.)
• This house was built in 1990.
(Bu uy 1990 yilda qurilgan.)
• The windows are cleaned every week.
(Derazalar har hafta tozalanadi.)

Kim qilganini aytish uchun by: The book was written by Navoi.

q.q: The film was directed ___ a famous director.
q.uz: Film mashhur rejissyor tomonidan suratga olingan.

title: is being done / has been done (passive 2)
lesson:
is/are being + past participle — hozir qilinyapti
has/have been + past participle — qilib bo'lingan

• The road is being repaired.
(Yo'l ta'mirlanyapti.)
• My car has been stolen!
(Mashinam o'g'irlab ketilibdi!)
• The rooms have been cleaned.
(Xonalar tozalab bo'lindi.)

q.q: My car ___ ! I can't find it. (steal)
The rooms ___ . They look nice now. (clean)
A new hotel ___ near the station now.
q.uz: Hozir vokzal yonida yangi mehmonxona qurilyapti.

q.q: All the tickets ___ . There are none left.
q.uz: Barcha chiptalar sotib bo'lingan. Birortasi qolmadi.

title: be / have / do in present and past tenses
lesson:
be + -ing (continuous) · be + past participle (passive)
have + past participle (perfect)
do / does / did — simple zamonda savol va inkor

• Are you working? · Was the car repaired?
• Have you finished? · Has she gone?
• Do you like it? · Did you see it?
(Yoqadimi? · Ko'rdingizmi?)

q.q: What ___ you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
q.uz: Kecha soat 8 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?

title: regular and irregular verbs
lesson:
Regular: past = past participle = -ed
work → worked → worked · stop → stopped → stopped

Irregular: o'zgacha shakllar, yodlash kerak
go → went → gone · see → saw → seen
take → took → taken · write → wrote → written
break → broke → broken · speak → spoke → spoken
buy → bought → bought · make → made → made

• I saw Ali yesterday.
(Kecha Alini ko'rdim.)
• I have seen this film.
(Bu filmni ko'rganman.)

q.q: She ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.

title: What are you doing tomorrow?
lesson:
Oldindan rejalashtirilgan, kelishilgan ishlar uchun am/is/are + -ing:

• What are you doing tomorrow?
(Ertaga nima qilyapsiz? / Ertaga rejangiz nima?)
• I'm meeting Ali on Friday.
(Juma kuni Ali bilan uchrashaman.)
• We're flying to Istanbul next week.
(Keyingi hafta Istanbulga uchamiz.)

Jadval (poyezd, film, dars) uchun present simple:
• The train leaves at 7.30.
(Poyezd 7:30 da jo'naydi.)

q.q: She ___ to the dentist on Monday. (go)
q.uz: U dushanba kuni tish shifokoriga boradi.

q.q: What time ___ the film start tonight?
q.uz: Bugun kechqurun film soat nechada boshlanadi?

title: I'm going to ...
lesson:
am/is/are going to + verb — niyat, qaror qilingan ish:
• I'm going to buy a new phone.
(Yangi telefon sotib olmoqchiman.)

Hozirgi belgilarga qarab bashorat:
• Look at the sky! It's going to rain.
(Osmonga qarang! Yomg'ir yog'adi.)

Negative: I'm not going to … · Question: Are you going to …?

q.q: I'm going ___ buy a new phone.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
What ___ you going to do this weekend?
We ___ going to watch the match. We're tired. (negative)
He ___ going to sell his car.
I'm going to ___ my homework now. (do)

title: will / shall 1
lesson:
will + verb — kelajak haqida fikr, bashorat:
• I think it will rain tomorrow.
(Menimcha, ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.)
• She'll be 20 next year.
(U keyingi yil 20 yoshga to'ladi.)

Negative: won't (will not) · Question: Will you …?
• I won't be at home tomorrow.
(Ertaga uyda bo'lmayman.)

q.q: Don't worry. The exam ___ be difficult. (negative)
Where ___ you be at 10 o'clock tomorrow?

title: will / shall 2
lesson:
Gapirayotgan paytda qaror qilsak — I'll:
• The phone is ringing. — I'll answer it.
(Telefon jiringlayapti. — Men ko'taraman.)
• I'm cold. — I'll close the window.
(Sovqotyapman. — Derazani yopaman.)

Taklif uchun Shall I / Shall we …?
• Shall I help you?
(Yordam beraymi?)
• Shall we go out tonight?
(Bugun kechqurun tashqariga chiqamizmi?)

q.q: The phone is ringing. — I ___ it.
I'm cold. — I ___ close the window.
___ I help you with your bag?
___ we go to the cinema tonight?
I'm hungry. — I ___ you a sandwich.
It's late. I think I ___ go home now.
q.uz: Kech bo'ldi. Menimcha, endi uyga boraman.

title: might
lesson:
might + verb = balki, ehtimol (aniq emas)

• I might go to the party.
(Balki ziyofatga borarman.)
• It might rain later.
(Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.)
• She might not come.
(U kelmasligi mumkin.)

⚠️ might dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda: might go (not goes / to go)

q.q: I ___ go to the party. I'm not sure.
She ___ not come. She's very busy.
I might ___ to London next year. (go)
Where are you going on holiday? — I'm not sure. I ___ go to Turkey.
q.uz: Ta'tilga qayerga borasiz? — Bilmayman. Balki Turkiyaga borarman.
Ehtiyot bo'ling. O'zingizga shikast yetkazishingiz mumkin.

q.q: He ___ not be at home. Call him first.
q.uz: U uyda bo'lmasligi mumkin. Avval qo'ng'iroq qiling.

title: can and could
lesson:
can — qila olaman (hozir) · could — qila olardim (o'tmishda)

• I can swim.
(Men suza olaman.)
• She can't drive.
(U mashina hayday olmaydi.)
• When I was young, I could run fast.
(Yoshligimda tez yugura olardim.)

Iltimos: Can / Could you help me?
(Menga yordam bera olasizmi?)

q.q: I ___ swim, but I can't dive.
q.uz: Men suza olaman, lekin sho'ng'iy olmayman.
U mashina hayday olmaydi. Hech o'rganmagan.

q.q: When I was young, I ___ run very fast.
I was tired, but I ___ sleep. (negative, past)
I'm sorry, I ___ come to your party yesterday.

title: must / mustn't / don't need to
lesson:
must — shart, zarur: I must go now.
(Hozir ketishim shart.)
mustn't — mumkin emas, taqiqlangan: You mustn't smoke here.
(Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas.)
don't need to — shart emas: You don't need to come.
(Kelishingiz shart emas.)

O'tmishda: must → had to: I had to work yesterday.
(Kecha ishlashga majbur bo'ldim.)

q.q: You ___ bring food. There's a lot here.
q.uz: Ovqat olib kelishingiz shart emas. Bu yerda ko'p.

q.q: You ___ tell anybody. It's a secret.
q.uz: Hech kimga aytmasligingiz kerak. Bu sir.

q.q: We ___ hurry. We have lots of time.
You ___ wear a seat belt in the car.

title: should
lesson:
should + verb — maslahat: ... qilish kerak, yaxshi bo'ladi

• You should go to bed early.
(Erta yotishingiz kerak.)
• You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
(Shuncha ko'p shakar yemasligingiz kerak.)
• I think you should see a doctor.
(Menimcha, shifokorga ko'rinishingiz kerak.)
• Should I call him?
(Unga qo'ng'iroq qilsammikan?)

q.q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
I think you should ___ a doctor.
___ I call him or send a message?
q.uz: Unga qo'ng'iroq qilaymi yoki xabar yuboraymi?

q.q: It's a great film. You ___ watch it.
q.uz: Ajoyib film. Uni albatta ko'rishingiz kerak.

q.q: He ___ drive so fast. It's dangerous. (negative)
q.uz: U bunchalik tez haydamasligi kerak. Xavfli.

title: I have to ...
lesson:
have to / has to = majburman (qoida, vaziyat sababli)

• I have to work on Saturdays.
(Shanba kunlari ishlashim kerak.)
• She has to wear a uniform.
(U forma kiyishi shart.)
• I had to wait for an hour.
(Bir soat kutishga majbur bo'ldim.)

don't have to = shart emas: You don't have to pay.
(To'lashingiz shart emas.)
Question: Do you have to …?

q.q: She ___ wear a uniform at work.
I ___ wait for an hour yesterday. (have to — past)
q.uz: Kecha bir soat kutishga majbur bo'ldim.

q.q: He ___ get up early tomorrow. It's Sunday.
q.uz: U ertaga erta turishi shart emas. Yakshanba.

q.q: What time ___ you have to leave yesterday?
q.uz: Kecha soat nechada ketishingiz kerak edi?

title: Would you like ...? I'd like ...
lesson:
Would you like …? — taklif (Xohlaysizmi?)
I'd like … (I would like) — xohlayman (muloyim)

• Would you like some tea?
(Choy ichasizmi?)
• Would you like to go out tonight?
(Bugun kechqurun tashqariga chiqishni xohlaysizmi?)
• I'd like a cup of coffee, please.
(Bir piyola qahva bering, iltimos.)

⚠️ Do you like tea? = umuman yoqtirasizmi? · Would you like tea? = hozir xohlaysizmi?

q.q: I'd ___ a cup of coffee, please.
Would you like ___ to the cinema tonight?
I ___ like to visit Japan one day.
Would you like some cake? — No, thank you. I'm ___ hungry.
q.uz: Tort yeysizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat. Och emasman.

q.q: I'd like ___ speak to the manager, please.

title: Do this! Don't do that! Let's do this!
lesson:
Buyruq: fe'lning asosiy shakli
• Come here!
(Bu yerga keling!)
• Please sit down.
(Iltimos, o'tiring.)

Inkor: Don't + verb
• Don't be late!
(Kechikmang!)

Taklif: Let's (let us) + verb
• Let's go to the park.
(Bog'ga boraylik.)
• Let's not go out.
(Tashqariga chiqmaylik.)

q.q: ___ be late! The lesson starts at 9.
It's a nice day. ___ go to the park.
I'm tired. — ___ have a rest then.

title: I used to ...
lesson:
used to + verb — o'tmishda odat bo'lgan, endi yo'q

• I used to play football. (Now I don't.)
(Ilgari futbol o'ynardim. Hozir o'ynamayman.)
• She used to live in Bukhara.
(U ilgari Buxoroda yashardi.)

Negative: didn't use to · Question: Did you use to …?
• I didn't use to like tea.
(Ilgari choyni yoqtirmasdim.)

q.q: I ___ to play football, but now I don't.
I ___ use to like tea, but now I love it.
q.uz: Ilgari choyni yoqtirmasdim, hozir juda yoqtiraman.

q.q: ___ you use to play the piano?
This building ___ a cinema. Now it's a shop.
q.uz: Bu bino ilgari kinoteatr edi. Endi do'kon.

q.q: We used to ___ to the sea every summer. (go)
He ___ to smoke, but he stopped.

title: there is / there are
lesson:
Biror narsa bor ekanini aytish uchun:
there is (there's) + birlik · there are + ko'plik

• There's a bank near here.
(Bu yer yaqinida bank bor.)
• There are five people in my family.
(Oilamizda besh kishi bor.)
• There isn't a hotel here.
(Bu yerda mehmonxona yo'q.)
• Is there a supermarket near here?
(Bu yer yaqinida supermarket bormi?)

q.q: There ___ five people in my family.
There ___ a hotel in this village. (negative)
How many students ___ there in your class?
There ___ any eggs in the fridge.
Is there a park near your house? — Yes, there ___.

title: there was / were — there has been — there will be
lesson:
• There was a party last night.
(Kecha kechqurun ziyofat bo'ldi.)
• There were many people at the concert.
(Konsertda odam ko'p edi.)
• There has been an accident.
(Avariya bo'libdi.)
• There will be a meeting tomorrow.
(Ertaga yig'ilish bo'ladi.)

q.q: There ___ many people at the concert.
There ___ be a meeting tomorrow at 10.
___ a lot of rain last week?
There ___ been a lot of changes in our city. (present perfect)

title: It ...
lesson:
Vaqt, ob-havo, masofa va baho uchun it ishlatiladi:

• It's 5 o'clock.
(Soat besh.)
• It's raining. · It's cold today.
(Yomg'ir yog'yapti. · Bugun sovuq.)
• It's 10 kilometres from here to the city.
(Bu yerdan shahargacha 10 km.)
• It's nice to see you.
(Sizni ko'rganimdan xursandman.)

⚠️ It is cold. (not Is cold.)

q.q: How far is ___ from here to the airport?

title: I am, I don't, etc.
lesson:
Fe'lni takrorlamaslik uchun faqat yordamchi fe'l ishlatamiz:

• She isn't tired, but I am.
(U charchamagan, lekin men charchadim.)
• I don't like fish, but my sister does.
(Men baliqni yoqtirmayman, opam esa yoqtiradi.)
• He can swim, but I can't.
(U suza oladi, lekin men suza olmayman.)
• Are you hungry? — Yes, I am.

q.q: I don't like fish, but my sister ___.
q.uz: Men baliqni yoqtirmayman, opam esa yoqtiradi.
U suza oladi, lekin men suza olmayman.

q.q: I wasn't at home, but my parents ___.
q.uz: Men uyda emas edim, ota-onam esa uyda edi.

q.q: Tom has a car, but I ___.
I've seen the film, but my friend ___.
q.uz: Men filmni ko'rganman, do'stim esa ko'rmagan.

q.q: Did you go to the party? — No, I ___.

title: Have you? Are you? Don't you? etc.
lesson:
Qiziqish bildirish uchun qisqa savol:
• I'm tired. — Are you?
(Charchadim. — Shundaymi?)
• I don't like tea. — Don't you?
(Choyni yoqtirmayman. — Rostdanmi?)

Gap oxiridagi so'roq (tag): ijobiy gap → inkor tag, inkor gap → ijobiy tag
• It's cold, isn't it?
(Sovuq, shunday emasmi?)
• You aren't busy, are you?
(Band emassiz, to'g'rimi?)

q.q: I was ill last week. — ___ you? I didn't know.
q.uz: O'tgan hafta kasal edim. — Shundaymi? Bilmagan ekanman.

title: too / either — so am I / neither do I
lesson:
Ijobiy gapga qo'shilish: too yoki So + aux + I
• I'm hungry. — I am too. / So am I.
(Men ham.)
• I like tea. — So do I.

Inkor gapga qo'shilish: either yoki Neither + aux + I
• I can't swim. — I can't either. / Neither can I.
(Men ham suza olmayman.)

q.q: I didn't see the film. — Neither ___ I.
I've been to Istanbul. — So ___ I.
I wasn't at home. — Neither ___ I.

title: isn't / haven't / don't etc. (negatives)
lesson:
be: I'm not · isn't · aren't · wasn't · weren't
have (perfect): haven't · hasn't
will / can: won't · can't
simple: don't · doesn't · didn't + verb

• She isn't here.
(U bu yerda emas.)
• I haven't finished.
(Tugatmadim.)
• He didn't call me.
(U menga qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.)

q.q: Make negative: She is here. → She ___ here.
q.uz: Inkor qiling: U bu yerda emas.

q.q: Make negative: I have finished. → I ___ finished.
Make negative: He called me. → He ___ me.
q.uz: Inkor qiling: U menga qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.

q.q: Make negative: They will come. → They ___ come.
Make negative: She likes coffee. → She ___ coffee.
Make negative: We can swim. → We ___ swim.
Make negative: It was cold. → It ___ cold.

title: is it ...? have you ...? do they ...? (questions 1)
lesson:
Savolda yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin keladi:
you are → are you? · she has been → has she been?
you live → do you live? · he went → did he go?

• Where do you live?
(Qayerda yashaysiz?)
• What time did she arrive?
(U soat nechada keldi?)
• Have you seen my phone?
(Telefonimni ko'rdingizmi?)

q.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz?

title: Who saw you? Who did you see? (questions 2)
lesson:
Who/What ega bo'lsa — do/did ishlatilmaydi:
• Who saw you? (Somebody saw you.)
(Sizni kim ko'rdi?)
• What happened?
(Nima bo'ldi?)

Who/What to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa — do/did kerak:
• Who did you see? (You saw somebody.)
(Siz kimni ko'rdingiz?)

q.q: Who ___ the window? — Tom broke it.
What ___ you want? — I want a coffee.
Who ___ this book? — Navoi wrote it.
q.uz: Bu kitobni kim yozgan? — Navoiy yozgan.

q.q: Who ___ you call last night? — I called my mother.
q.uz: Kecha kechqurun kimga qo'ng'iroq qildingiz? — Onamga.

title: Who is she talking to? What is it like?
lesson:
Predlog odatda savol oxirida qoladi:
• Who is she talking to?
(U kim bilan gaplashyapti?)
• Where are you from?
(Qayerdansiz?)
• What are you looking at?
(Nimaga qarayapsiz?)

What is it like? = U qanaqa? (tavsif so'raladi)
• What's your new teacher like? — She's very nice.
(Yangi o'qituvchingiz qanaqa? — Juda yoqimli.)

q.q: What's the weather ___ today? — It's sunny.
What's your new flat ___ ? — It's small but nice.
q.uz: Yangi kvartirangiz qanaqa? — Kichik, lekin yaxshi.

q.q: What is this book ___? — It's about history.
q.uz: Bu kitob nima haqida? — Tarix haqida.

q.q: Who did you go to the cinema ___?

title: What ...? Which ...? How ...?
lesson:
What — umumiy, tanlov chegaralanmagan:
• What colour is your car?
(Mashinangiz qanday rangda?)
Which — kam variantdan tanlash:
• Which is your bag, this one or that one?
(Qaysi biri sizning sumkangiz, bumi yoki u?)
How + sifat: how old, how tall, how far, how often, how much, how many
• How far is it to the airport?
(Aeroportgacha qancha masofa?)

q.q: There are two bags. ___ one is yours?
q.uz: Ikkita sumka bor. Qaysi biri sizniki?

q.q: How ___ is it from here to the city centre? — 5 km.
q.uz: Bu yerdan shahar markazigacha qancha? — 5 km.

q.q: How ___ do you go to the gym? — Three times a week.
q.uz: Sport zaliga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — Haftada uch marta.

q.q: How ___ people were at the party? — About 50.
q.uz: Ziyofatda qancha odam bor edi? — 50 ga yaqin.

title: How long does it take ...?
lesson:
Biror ishga qancha vaqt ketishini so'rash:
How long does it take (to do something)?

• How long does it take to get to the airport?
(Aeroportga yetib borish qancha vaqt oladi?)
• It takes 30 minutes by taxi.
(Taksida 30 daqiqa ketadi.)
• It took me two hours to do my homework.
(Uy vazifamni qilishga ikki soat ketdi.)

q.q: How long does it ___ to get to the airport?
It ___ me two hours to do my homework yesterday. (take)
q.uz: Kecha uy vazifamni qilishga ikki soat ketdi.

q.q: How long ___ it take you to get to work?
How long ___ it take to build the house? (past)
It takes an hour ___ there by car.
q.uz: U yerga mashinada borishga bir soat ketadi.

q.q: How ___ does it take to learn English?
q.uz: Ingliz tilini o'rganishga qancha vaqt ketadi?

q.q: It ___ three hours to fly to Istanbul.

title: Do you know where ...? I don't know what ...
lesson:
Ichki savolda so'z tartibi oddiy gapdagidek bo'ladi:
Where is the station? → Do you know where the station is?
What time does it start? → I don't know what time it starts.

• Do you know where Ali lives?
(Ali qayerda yashashini bilasizmi?)
• Ha/yo'q savollarda if: Do you know if she's at home?
(U uydami yoki yo'qmi, bilasizmi?)

q.q: Do you know ___ she's at home? (yes/no question)
Can you tell me how much ___ ?
I wonder ___ he will come or not.

title: She said that ... He told me that ...
lesson:
Birovning so'zini yetkazganda zamon odatda bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi:
am/is → was · are → were · have → had · will → would · can → could · do → did

• "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
(U charchaganini aytdi.)
• "I'll call you." → He told me he would call me.
(U menga qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.)

say something · tell somebody something

q.q: "I'll call you." → He said he ___ call me.
He ___ me that he was busy.
She ___ that she liked the film.
"I can swim." → Tom said he ___ swim.
"We are hungry." → They said they ___ hungry.
"I have lost my key." → She said she ___ lost her key.

title: work / working · go / going · do / doing
lesson:
Asosiy shakl (verb) — will, can, must, should, might, do/does/did dan keyin:
• I can swim. · Did you go?

to + verb — want, need, try, hope dan keyin:
• I want to go.

-ing — am/is/are/was/were dan keyin (continuous):
• She is working.

• He can't come.
(U kela olmaydi.)
• I need to buy some bread.
(Non sotib olishim kerak.)

q.q: They were ___ TV when I came. (watch)
q.uz: Men kelganimda ular televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
Sizni tez orada yana ko'rishga umid qilaman.

title: to ... (I want to do) and -ing (I enjoy doing)
lesson:
+ to: want, hope, decide, need, plan, learn, promise, forget
• I decided to leave.
(Ketishga qaror qildim.)

+ -ing: enjoy, finish, stop, mind, suggest, keep
• I enjoy reading.
(O'qishni yoqtiraman.)

Ikkalasi ham: like, love, hate, start, begin
• It started to rain / raining.

q.uz: Sizni tez orada ko'rishga umid qilaman.

q.q: Please stop ___ ! I'm trying to sleep.
q.uz: Iltimos, gapirishni bas qiling! Uxlashga harakat qilyapman.

q.q: She learnt ___ when she was five. (swim)

title: I want you to ... I told you to ...
lesson:
want / ask / tell / advise / would like + somebody + to + verb

• I want you to help me.
(Menga yordam berishingizni xohlayman.)
• She told me to wait.
(U menga kutishimni aytdi.)
• The doctor advised him to rest.
(Shifokor unga dam olishni maslahat berdi.)

⚠️ I want you to come. (not I want that you come)
make / let + somebody + verb (to siz): She let me go.

q.uz: Shifokor unga dam olishni maslahat berdi.

q.q: My parents won't let me ___ out late.
q.uz: Ota-onam kechgacha tashqarida yurishimga ruxsat bermaydi.

q.q: I asked Ali ___ close the door.
The teacher told us ___ to be late. (negative)

q.uz: U meni qayta qilishga majbur qildi.

title: I went to the shop to ...
lesson:
Maqsadni aytish uchun to + verb:
• I went to the shop to buy bread.
(Non olish uchun do'konga bordim.)
• She called me to say hello.
(U salom berish uchun qo'ng'iroq qildi.)

for + noun:
• I went to the shop for some bread.
(Non uchun do'konga bordim.)

⚠️ I went there to buy … (not for buy / for to buy)

q.q: I went to the shop ___ some bread.
q.uz: Non sotib olish uchun do'konga bordim.

q.q: I went to the shop ___ some bread.

q.uz: U salom berish uchun qo'ng'iroq qildi.

q.q: We went to the café ___ a coffee.
I'm saving money ___ a new car.
q.uz: Yangi mashina olish uchun pul yig'yapman.

q.q: He went to London ___ study English.
q.uz: U ingliz tilini o'rganish uchun Londonga ketdi.

title: go to ... go on ... go for ... go -ing
lesson:
go to + joy: go to work, go to the bank
go on: go on holiday, go on a trip
go for: go for a walk, go for a swim, go for a drink
go + -ing (faoliyat): go shopping, go swimming, go skiing

• We went on holiday to Turkey.
(Ta'tilga Turkiyaga bordik.)
• Let's go for a walk.
(Sayr qilgani chiqaylik.)
• She goes shopping on Saturdays.
(U shanba kunlari xarid qilgani boradi.)

q.uz: U shanba kunlari xarid qilgani boradi.

q.q: Do you want to go ___ ? It's hot today. (swim)
They went ___ a trip to Khiva.
We went ___ a drink after work.
I'd like to go ___ in the mountains this winter. (ski)
q.uz: Bu qish tog'da chang'i uchgani borishni xohlayman.

title: get
lesson:
get ko'p ma'noli fe'l:
get + narsa = olmoq: I got a letter.
(Xat oldim.)
get + sifat = bo'lib qolmoq: It's getting dark.
(Qorong'i tushyapti.)
get to / get home = yetib bormoq: I got home at 10.
(Uyga soat 10 da yetib keldim.)
get up = turmoq · get married = turmush qurmoq
get on/off (bus) · get in/out of (car)

q.q: What time did you ___ home last night?
q.uz: Kecha kechqurun uyga soat nechada yetib keldingiz?

q.q: Get ___ the bus at the next stop.
I ___ a message from Ali this morning. (get — past)
She got ___ the car and drove away.
How do you ___ to work? — By metro.

title: do and make
lesson:
do — ish, faoliyat: do homework, do housework, do the shopping, do an exam, do exercise, do your best
make — yaratish, yasash: make a cake, make tea, make a mistake, make a noise, make a phone call, make a decision, make money

• I did my homework.
(Uy vazifamni qildim.)
• Don't make a noise.
(Shovqin qilmang.)

q.q: Can you ___ a cup of tea?
I ___ a mistake in the test.
Who ___ the shopping in your family?
I need to ___ a phone call.
You should ___ some exercise every day.
q.uz: Har kuni biroz mashq qilishingiz kerak.

q.q: We have to ___ a decision today.

title: have
lesson:
have ko'p iboralarda "qilmoq" ma'nosida:
have breakfast/lunch/dinner · have a shower · have a rest · have a party · have a good time · have a look

• I usually have breakfast at 7.
(Odatda soat 7 da nonushta qilaman.)
• Have a good time!
(Yaxshi dam oling!)

⚠️ Bu ma'noda continuous mumkin: She's having a shower.
("egalik" ma'nosida emas: I'm having a car ✗)

q.q: ___ a good time at the party!
Can I ___ a look at your photos?
You look tired. You should ___ a rest.
I ___ a car. (= I own a car)

title: I / me · he / him · they / them
lesson:
Ega: I · you · he · she · it · we · they
To'ldiruvchi: me · you · him · her · it · us · them

• I know her. She knows me.
(Men uni taniyman. U meni taniydi.)
• Call us tomorrow.
(Ertaga bizga qo'ng'iroq qiling.)
• Give it to them.
(Buni ularga bering.)

q.q: I know Sara. I know ___ well.
q.uz: Men Sarani taniyman. Uni yaxshi bilaman.

q.q: Ali and I are friends. ___ go to the same school.
q.uz: Ali va men do'stmiz. Biz bir maktabga boramiz.

q.q: Where's Tom? I want to talk to ___.
These are my books. Can you give ___ to me?
q.uz: Bular mening kitoblarim. Ularni menga bera olasizmi?

q.q: Can you help ___? I can't do this. (I)
q.uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Buni qila olmayapman.

q.q: ___ is my sister. Her name is Lola.
q.uz: Bu mening singlim. Uning ismi Lola.
Biz uydamiz. Keyinroq bizga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

q.q: My parents live in Bukhara. I visit ___ every month.
q.uz: Ota-onam Buxoroda yashaydi. Ularni har oy ko'rgani boraman.

title: my / his / their etc.
lesson:
I → my · you → your · he → his · she → her
it → its · we → our · they → their

• This is my brother. His name is Ali.
(Bu mening akam. Uning ismi Ali.)
• They love their children.
(Ular farzandlarini yaxshi ko'radi.)

⚠️ its (uning — narsa/hayvon) · it's = it is

q.q: This is my brother. ___ name is Ali.
q.uz: Bu mening akam. Uning ismi Ali.

q.q: This is my sister. ___ name is Lola.
q.uz: Bu mening singlim. Uning ismi Lola.

q.q: Is this ___ bag? — Yes, it's mine.
I'm Tom and this is ___ wife.

title: Whose is this? It's mine / yours / hers
lesson:
my → mine · your → yours · his → his · her → hers
our → ours · their → theirs

Otdan keyin emas, o'zi yolg'iz ishlatiladi:
• This is my bag. → This bag is mine.
(Bu sumka meniki.)
• Whose is this phone? — It's hers.
(Bu telefon kimniki? — Uniki.)
• a friend of mine
(do'stlarimdan biri)

q.q: Is this your pen? — Yes, it's ___ .
These aren't our keys. ___ are on the table.
q.uz: Bular bizning kalitlarimiz emas. Biznikilar stol ustida.

q.q: That car belongs to my parents. It's ___.
Is this Lola's book? — Yes, it's ___.
Is this umbrella ___ ? — No, it isn't mine.
q.uz: Bu soyabon siznikimi? — Yo'q, meniki emas.

title: I / me / my / mine
lesson:
I · me · my · mine
you · you · your · yours
he · him · his · his
she · her · her · hers
we · us · our · ours
they · them · their · theirs

• I gave my book to him. Now it's his.
(Men kitobimni unga berdim. Endi u uniki.)

q.q: Where are Ali's shoes? — ___ shoes are here. (he)
q.uz: Alining tuflisi qayerda? — Uning tuflisi shu yerda.

q.q: We know them, and they know ___.
q.uz: Biz ularni taniymiz, ular ham bizni taniydi.

title: myself / yourself / themselves
lesson:
myself · yourself · himself · herself · itself · ourselves · yourselves · themselves

Ega va to'ldiruvchi bir shaxs bo'lsa:
• I cut myself.
(O'zimni kesib oldim.)
by myself = yolg'iz, o'zim:
• She lives by herself.
(U yolg'iz yashaydi.)

each other = bir-birini: They love each other.
(Ular bir-birini yaxshi ko'radi.)

q.q: I cut ___ while I was cooking.

q.uz: Ali va Lola bir-birini yaxshi ko'radi.

q.q: He taught ___ to play the guitar.

title: -'s (Kate's camera / my brother's car)
lesson:
Odam yoki hayvonga tegishlilik: -'s
• Kate's camera
(Keytning fotoapparati)
• my brother's car
(akamning mashinasi)

Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa — faqat ': my parents' house
(ota-onamning uyi)
Lekin: the children's toys, the men's room

Narsalar uchun ko'pincha of: the name of the street

q.q: This is the car of my brother. → This is my ___ car.
Is this Ali's phone? — No, it's ___ . (Lola)
Who is that? — It's my ___ husband. (sister)

title: a / an
lesson:
a + undosh tovush: a car, a book, a university (yu-)
an + unli tovush: an apple, an hour (h o'qilmaydi), an umbrella

Kasb aytishda: She's a doctor.
(U shifokor.)
Birinchi marta tilga olinganda: I bought a new phone.
(Yangi telefon sotib oldim.)

q.q: I bought ___ new car last week.

title: train(s) / bus(es) (singular and plural)
lesson:
Odatda -s: book → books, car → cars
-es: bus → buses, box → boxes, watch → watches
-y → -ies: city → cities (lekin day → days)
-f → -ves: knife → knives, wife → wives

Noto'g'ri: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people, mouse → mice

Doim ko'plik: trousers, jeans, glasses, scissors

q.q: There were a lot of ___ at the concert.

title: a bottle / some water (countable / uncountable 1)
lesson:
Sanaladigan: a book, two books, a banana
Sanalmaydigan: water, money, rice, bread, music, information, advice, furniture
— a/an va ko'plik -s olmaydi!

• I need some water. (not a water)
(Menga biroz suv kerak.)
• a bottle of water · a piece of bread · a cup of tea
(bir shisha suv · bir bo'lak non · bir piyola choy)

q.q: I'd like a ___ of tea, please.
Can I have a ___ of bread?

title: a cake / some cake / some cakes (countable / uncountable 2)
lesson:
a/an + birlik sanaladigan: a cake (butun tort)
some + ko'plik: some cakes (bir nechta tort)
some + sanalmaydigan: some cake (tortdan bir qism)

• Would you like some coffee?
(Qahva ichasizmi?)
• I bought some apples.
(Olma sotib oldim.)
• We need some new chairs.
(Bizga yangi stullar kerak.)

q.q: I bought ___ apples at the market.

q.uz: Bizga bir nechta yangi stul kerak.

q.q: Can I have ___ cake? Just a small piece.
q.uz: Tortdan bir oz olsam bo'ladimi? Kichkina bo'lak.

title: a / an and the
lesson:
a/an — birinchi marta, qaysiligi noma'lum
the — qaysi ekanligi aniq, ilgari aytilgan, yagona

• I saw a dog. The dog was very big.
(Bir it ko'rdim. It juda katta edi.)
• Can you close the door, please?
(Eshikni yopib qo'ya olasizmi?)
• the sun · the moon · the sky

q.q: I saw ___ dog in the park. ___ dog was very big.
q.uz: Bog'da bir it ko'rdim. It juda katta edi.

q.q: I have ___ brother and a sister.
q.uz: Mening bitta akam va bitta opam bor.

q.q: She bought a dress and a hat. ___ dress was red.
q.uz: U ko'ylak va shlyapa sotib oldi. Ko'ylak qizil edi.

title: the ...
lesson:
the ishlatiladi: the same, the first/second, the cinema, the theatre, the radio, the sea, the internet
• in the morning / afternoon / evening

the ishlatilmaydi: TV (watch TV), breakfast/lunch/dinner, next/last week
• at night · at home · at work

• I watch TV in the evening.
(Kechqurun televizor ko'raman.)
• We went to the cinema last week.
(O'tgan hafta kinoga bordik.)

q.q: I usually watch ___ TV in the evening.
What did you have for ___ breakfast?
I always go for a walk in ___ morning.
She was ___ first person to arrive.

title: go to work / go home / go to the cinema
lesson:
the siz: go to work, go to school, go to university, go to bed, go to hospital, go home (to siz!)
the bilan: go to the cinema, the bank, the station, the doctor, the shop

• I go to work by bus.
(Ishga avtobusda boraman.)
• It's late. Let's go home.
(Kech bo'ldi. Uyga ketaylik.)
• I need to go to the bank.
(Bankka borishim kerak.)

q.q: I need to go to ___ bank.
What time do you go to ___ ?
My son is 7. He goes to ___ now. (maktab)
I have a toothache. I must go to ___ dentist.
q.uz: Tishim og'riyapti. Tish shifokoriga borishim kerak.

title: I like music · I hate exams
lesson:
Umuman gapirganda the ishlatilmaydi:
• I like music.
(Musiqani yoqtiraman.)
• Dogs are friendly animals.
(Itlar do'stona hayvonlar.)
• Life is short.
(Hayot qisqa.)

Aniq narsa haqida — the:
• The music at the party was loud.
(Ziyofatdagi musiqa baland edi.)

q.q: ___ music at the party was very loud.
___ vegetables in this shop are very fresh.
Can you pass me ___ salt, please?

title: the ... (names of places)
lesson:
the siz: mamlakatlar (Uzbekistan, France), shaharlar, qit'alar (Asia), ko'llar, tog'lar (Everest), ko'chalar
the bilan: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands · daryolar (the Amudarya), dengizlar, okeanlar (the Atlantic), cho'llar (the Sahara), tog' tizmalari (the Alps)
Mehmonxona, muzey, teatr: the Hilton, the British Museum

q.q: ___ Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan.

title: this / that / these / those
lesson:
Yaqin: this (birlik) · these (ko'plik)
Uzoq: that (birlik) · those (ko'plik)

• This is my phone.
(Bu mening telefonim.)
• Look at those birds!
(Anavi qushlarga qarang!)
• Who's that man?
(Anavi odam kim?)
• That's a good idea!
(Bu yaxshi fikr!)

q.q: Look at ___ birds in the sky!
___ shoes are very comfortable. (I'm wearing them)
I'll have pizza. — ___ a good idea!
___ are my children, Ali and Lola. (here, near me)
q.uz: Bular mening farzandlarim, Ali va Lola.

q.q: Hello, ___ is Ali speaking. (on the phone)

title: one / ones
lesson:
Otni takrorlamaslik uchun:
one — birlik · ones — ko'plik

• I don't like this shirt. I'll take the blue one.
(Bu ko'ylak yoqmadi. Ko'k rangdagisini olaman.)
• These shoes are old. I need new ones.
(Bu tuflilar eski. Menga yangilari kerak.)
• Which one? · Which ones?
(Qaysi biri? · Qaysilari?)

q.q: I don't like this shirt. I'll take the blue ___ .
q.uz: Bu ko'ylak yoqmadi. Ko'k rangdagisini olaman.

q.q: These shoes are old. I need new ___ .
q.uz: Bu tuflilar eski. Menga yangilari kerak.

q.q: Which ___ do you want, the big one or the small one?
q.uz: Qaysi birini xohlaysiz, kattasinimi yoki kichigini?

q.q: I need a pen. Have you got ___ ?
Those apples are bad. Take these ___ . They're fresh.
q.uz: Anavi olmalar yomon. Bularini oling. Yangi.

q.q: Which ___ are yours? — The black ones.
My car is old. I want a new ___ .
This cup is dirty. Can I have a clean ___ ?
q.uz: Bu piyola kir. Tozasini bera olasizmi?

title: some and any
lesson:
some — ijobiy gaplarda, taklif va iltimosda:
• I've got some money.
(Biroz pulim bor.)
• Would you like some tea?

any — inkor va savolda:
• I haven't got any money.
(Umuman pulim yo'q.)
• Are there any shops near here?
(Bu yer yaqinida do'konlar bormi?)

q.q: There aren't ___ eggs in the fridge.
Have you got ___ brothers or sisters?

title: not + any · no · none
lesson:
not … any = no + ot
• There aren't any shops. = There are no shops.
(Do'konlar yo'q.)

none — otsiz, yolg'iz ishlatiladi:
• How many children have they got? — None.
(Nechta farzandi bor? — Birorta ham yo'q.)

⚠️ Bitta inkor yetarli: There are no shops. (not There aren't no shops)

q.q: There aren't any shops here. = There are ___ shops here.
How much money have you got? — ___ .
I have ___ time today. I'm very busy.
q.uz: Bugun umuman vaqtim yo'q. Juda bandman.

q.q: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
I wanted some cake, but there was ___ left.
q.uz: Tort yemoqchi edim, lekin hech narsa qolmabdi.

q.q: We've got ___ bread. Can you buy some?
___ of my friends came to the party.

title: not + anybody / anything · nobody / nothing
lesson:
not … anybody/anyone = nobody/no-one (hech kim)
not … anything = nothing (hech narsa)

• I didn't see anybody. = I saw nobody.
(Hech kimni ko'rmadim.)
• She didn't say anything. = She said nothing.
(U hech narsa demadi.)
• Nobody called.
(Hech kim qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.)

q.uz: U hech narsa demadi. Jim edi.
Siz yo'qligingizda hech kim qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.

q.q: There's ___ in the box. It's empty.
What did you buy? — ___ . I didn't have any money.
q.uz: Nima sotib oldingiz? — Hech narsa. Pulim yo'q edi.
U kun bo'yi hech narsa yemadi.

q.q: Who was at home? — ___ . The house was empty.
q.uz: Uyda kim bor edi? — Hech kim. Uy bo'sh edi.

title: somebody / anything / nowhere etc.
lesson:
somebody/someone — kimdir · something — nimadir · somewhere — qayerdadir
anybody · anything · anywhere — savol va inkorda
nobody · nothing · nowhere — hech kim, hech narsa, hech qayerda

• Somebody is at the door.
(Eshik oldida kimdir bor.)
• I want to go somewhere warm.
(Qayergadir issiq joyga borishni xohlayman.)
• Did you go anywhere?
(Biror joyga bordingizmi?)

q.q: ___ is at the door. Can you open it?
q.uz: Eshik oldida kimdir bor. Ochib bera olasizmi?
O'tgan dam olish kunlari biror joyga bordingizmi?

q.q: I'm hungry. I want ___ to eat.
I lost my keys. I can't find them ___ .
q.uz: Kalitlarimni yo'qotdim. Hech qayerdan topa olmayapman.

q.q: Is there ___ in the room? — No, it's empty.
q.uz: Xonada biror kishi bormi? — Yo'q, bo'sh.

q.q: There's ___ to sit. All the chairs are taken.
q.uz: O'tirishga joy yo'q. Hamma stullar band.

title: every and all
lesson:
every + birlik ot: every day, every student
• I go to the gym every day.
(Har kuni sport zaliga boraman.)

all + ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan: all students, all day
• All the students passed the exam.
(Barcha talabalar imtihondan o'tdi.)

every day = har kuni · all day = kun bo'yi
everybody/everything + birlik fe'l: Everybody is here.

q.q: I go to the gym ___ day.
I was at home ___ day yesterday. I didn't go out.
q.uz: Kecha kun bo'yi uyda edim. Tashqariga chiqmadim.

title: all / most / some / any / no / none
lesson:
Umumiy: most people, some cars, no money
Aniq guruh: most of my friends, some of the cars, none of them

• Most people like music.
(Ko'pchilik musiqani yoqtiradi.)
• Most of my friends live in Tashkent.
(Do'stlarimning ko'pi Toshkentda yashaydi.)
• None of them came.
(Ulardan hech biri kelmadi.)

⚠️ most of the / most of my (not most of people)

q.q: I invited five friends, but ___ them came.
q.uz: Besh do'stimni taklif qildim, lekin hech biri kelmadi.

q.q: ___ of the students passed. Only two failed. (ko'pchilik)
q.uz: Talabalarning ko'pi o'tdi. Faqat ikkitasi yiqildi.

q.q: Some ___ the books are very old.
Did ___ of you see the film? (birortangiz)

title: both / either / neither
lesson:
both — ikkalasi ham: Both restaurants are good.
(Ikkala restoran ham yaxshi.)
either — ikkalasidan biri, farqi yo'q: We can go to either restaurant.
(Istalgan biriga borishimiz mumkin.)
neither — ikkalasi ham emas: Neither restaurant is open.
(Ikkalasi ham ochiq emas.)

both … and · either … or · neither … nor

q.q: I have two brothers. ___ of them are students.
q.uz: Ikki akam bor. Ikkalasi ham talaba.

q.q: Tea or coffee? — ___ . I don't mind.
q.uz: Choymi yoki qahva? — Farqi yo'q, istalgan biri.

q.q: ___ of my parents speak English. They speak only Uzbek.

q.uz: U ham inglizcha, ham ruscha gapiradi.

q.q: You can have ___ tea or coffee.
___ Ali nor Tom came to the lesson.
q.uz: Ali ham, Tom ham darsga kelmadi.

q.q: There are two roads. You can take ___ road.
q.uz: Ikki yo'l bor. Istalganidan borishingiz mumkin.

title: a lot / much / many
lesson:
many + sanaladigan ko'plik: many books, many people
much + sanalmaydigan: much money, much time
a lot of — ikkalasiga ham (ayniqsa ijobiy gapda)

• How many children have they got?
(Ularning nechta farzandi bor?)
• I don't have much time.
(Vaqtim ko'p emas.)
• She has a lot of friends.
(Uning do'stlari ko'p.)

q.q: There weren't ___ people at the party.
Did you take ___ photos on holiday?

title: (a) little / (a) few
lesson:
a little + sanalmaydigan: biroz (yetarli)
a few + ko'plik: bir nechta (yetarli)
• I have a little money. Let's go out.
(Biroz pulim bor. Tashqariga chiqaylik.)
• I have a few friends here.
(Bu yerda bir nechta do'stim bor.)

little / few (a siz): juda oz, deyarli yo'q
• He has few friends. He's lonely.
(Uning do'stlari juda oz. U yolg'iz.)

q.q: I have ___ money. Let's go out for dinner.
q.uz: Biroz pulim bor. Kechki ovqatga chiqaylik.
Bu yerda bir nechta do'stim bor.

q.q: He has ___ friends. He's very lonely.
q.uz: Uning do'stlari juda oz. U juda yolg'iz.

q.q: Can I have a ___ milk in my tea?
I'll be ready in a ___ minutes.
We stayed in Samarkand for ___ days.

title: old / nice / interesting (adjectives)
lesson:
Sifat otdan oldin keladi va ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi:
• a nice day · nice days (not nices)
• an old house
(eski uy)

be/look/feel/smell/taste/sound + sifat:
• You look tired.
(Charchagan ko'rinasiz.)
• This soup tastes good.
(Bu sho'rva mazali.)

⚠️ a red big car ✗ → a big red car ✓ (o'lcham → rang)

q.q: It's a ___ day today. The sun is shining. (nice)
q.uz: Bugun yoqimli kun. Quyosh charaqlab turibdi.

title: quickly / badly / suddenly (adverbs)
lesson:
Ravish ish-harakat qanday bajarilishini bildiradi: sifat + -ly
quick → quickly · slow → slowly · careful → carefully · easy → easily

• He drives carefully.
(U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.)
• She speaks English very well.
(U inglizchada juda yaxshi gapiradi.)

⚠️ good → well · fast → fast · hard → hard · late → late

q.q: She works very ___ . She's never tired. (hard)
q.uz: U juda qattiq ishlaydi. Hech charchamaydi.

title: old / older · expensive / more expensive
lesson:
Qisqa sifat + -er: old → older, cheap → cheaper, big → bigger, easy → easier
Uzun sifat: more + sifat: more expensive, more interesting

Noto'g'ri: good → better · bad → worse · far → further/farther

• My brother is older than me.
(Akam mendan katta.)
• This book is more interesting.
(Bu kitob qiziqroq.)

q.q: This book is ___ than that one.
Moscow is ___ than Tashkent in winter.
The weather today is ___ than yesterday.

title: older than ... · more expensive than ...
lesson:
• My brother is older than me.
(Akam mendan katta.)
• Trains are faster than buses.
(Poyezdlar avtobuslardan tezroq.)

Farqni kuchaytirish: much / a lot / a bit + comparative
• Your car is much bigger than mine.
(Mashinangiz menikidan ancha katta.)
• It's a bit cheaper.
(Biroz arzonroq.)

q.q: Your car is ___ bigger than mine.
This phone is ___ expensive than that one.
She's a ___ taller than her sister. (biroz)
I'm ___ at maths than my brother.
This exam was ___ than the last one.

title: not as ... as
lesson:
as + sifat + as — teng: Ali is as tall as Tom.
(Ali Tom bilan bir xil bo'yda.)
not as … as — kamroq: Bukhara isn't as big as Tashkent.
(Buxoro Toshkentchalik katta emas.)

• I'm not as old as you.
(Men sizchalik katta emasman.)
the same as: Your phone is the same as mine.
(Telefoningiz menikiga o'xshash/bir xil.)

q.uz: Ali Tom bilan bir xil bo'yda.

q.q: Your phone is the same ___ mine.
The film wasn't ___ good as the book.
He's not as ___ as his brother.
My English is not as good ___ yours.

title: the oldest · the most expensive
lesson:
Qisqa sifat: the + -est: old → the oldest, big → the biggest, easy → the easiest
Uzun sifat: the most + sifat: the most expensive
Noto'g'ri: good → the best · bad → the worst

• Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
(Everest dunyodagi eng baland tog'.)
• It's the best film I've ever seen.
(Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.)

q.q: Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
It's the ___ film I've ever seen. (good)
q.uz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yaxshi film.

q.q: This is ___ hotel in the city.
Ali is the ___ student in our class.
What's the ___ river in the world?

title: enough
lesson:
enough + ot: enough money, enough time
• I don't have enough money.
(Pulim yetarli emas.)

sifat + enough: old enough, big enough
• He isn't old enough to drive.
(U mashina haydashga hali yosh.)

• Is the room warm enough for you?
(Xona sizga yetarlicha issiqmi?)

q.q: This bag isn't big ___ for all my things.
q.uz: Bu sumka barcha narsalarimga yetarlicha katta emas.

title: too
lesson:
too + sifat = haddan tashqari, juda (salbiy):
• This coffee is too hot. I can't drink it.
(Bu qahva juda issiq. Icholmayman.)

too much + sanalmaydigan · too many + ko'plik
• There's too much traffic.
(Tirbandlik haddan ziyod.)
• There are too many people here.
(Bu yerda odam juda ko'p.)

too … to: It's too cold to swim.
(Suzish uchun juda sovuq.)

q.q: This coffee is ___ . I can't drink it.
There are ___ people here. Let's go.
q.uz: Bu yerda odam juda ko'p. Ketaylik.

q.q: He's ___ young to watch this film.
q.uz: U bu filmni ko'rish uchun juda yosh.

q.q: I ate too ___ cake. Now I feel sick.
q.uz: Juda ko'p tort yedim. Endi ko'nglim aynayapti.

q.q: These shoes are ___ . I need a bigger size.
q.uz: Bu tuflilar juda kichik. Kattaroq o'lcham kerak.

q.q: You make too ___ mistakes. Be careful.
q.uz: Juda ko'p xato qilyapsiz. Ehtiyot bo'ling.

title: He speaks English very well. (word order 1)
lesson:
Fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga boshqa so'z qo'yilmaydi:
• He speaks English very well. (not speaks very well English)
(U inglizchada juda yaxshi gapiradi.)
• I like music very much. (not like very much music)
(Musiqani juda yoqtiraman.)

Joy + vaqt tartibi: where → when
• I went to the bank yesterday.
(Kecha bankka bordim.)

q.uz: U har kuni ertalab qahva ichadi.
Biz ishga soat 8 da yetib keldik.
Ular uch yildan beri Londonda yashashadi.
o: have lived in London for three years
have lived for three years in London in
in London have lived for three years

title: always / usually / often (word order 2)
lesson:
always · usually · often · sometimes · rarely · never — asosiy fe'ldan oldin:
• I always get up early.
(Men doim erta turaman.)

Lekin be dan keyin:
• She is always late.
(U doim kechikadi.)

Yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: I have never been there. · I can never remember.

q.uz: Men u yerda hech qachon bo'lmaganman.

q.q: We ___ to the cinema on Sundays.
q.uz: Biz odatda yakshanba kunlari kinoga boramiz.
U ishdan keyin ko'pincha charchagan bo'ladi.

title: still / yet / already
lesson:
still = hali ham (davom etyapti): It's still raining.
(Hali ham yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
yet = hali (inkor/savol, gap oxirida): He hasn't come yet.
(U hali kelmadi.)
already = allaqachon (kutilganidan oldin): I've already eaten.
(Allaqachon ovqatlandim.)

• Do you still live in Tashkent?
(Hali ham Toshkentda yashaysizmi?)

q.uz: Hali ham yomg'ir yog'yapti. Soyabon oling.

q.q: Do you ___ live in Tashkent? (hali ham)
It's only 9 o'clock and she's ___ gone to bed.
q.uz: Soat endi 9 bo'ldi, u esa allaqachon yotib qoldi.

q.q: I ___ don't understand. Can you explain again?

title: Give me that book! Give it to me!
lesson:
give/send/show/lend/buy + kishi + narsa:
• Give me the book.
(Kitobni menga bering.)
narsa + to/for + kishi:
• Give the book to me.

Narsa it/them bo'lsa, faqat ikkinchi shakl:
• Give it to me. (not Give me it)
(Uni menga bering.)
• I bought a present for my mother.
(Onamga sovg'a sotib oldim.)

q.q: I sent a letter ___ my friend.
I bought a present ___ my mother.
These are Tom's keys. Can you give ___ ?
q.uz: Bular Tomning kalitlari. Ularni unga bera olasizmi?

title: at 8 o'clock · on Monday · in April
lesson:
at + soat: at 8 o'clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend
on + kun/sana: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday
in + oy/yil/fasl/kun qismi: in April, in 2025, in summer, in the morning

• The lesson starts at 9.
(Dars soat 9 da boshlanadi.)
• I was born in 1995.
(Men 1995 yilda tug'ilganman.)

⚠️ next/last/this/every oldidan predlog yo'q: next week, last Monday

title: from ... to · until · since · for
lesson:
from … to: I work from 9 to 5.
(9 dan 5 gacha ishlayman.)
until / till = … gacha: I'll wait until 6.
(Soat 6 gacha kutaman.)
since + boshlanish nuqtasi: I've lived here since 2015.
for + davomiylik: I lived there for three years.
(U yerda uch yil yashadim.)

q.q: We stayed in Khiva ___ three days.
The shop is open ___ 8 am to 10 pm.
q.uz: Do'kon ertalab 8 dan kechki 10 gacha ochiq.

q.q: Let's stay here ___ the rain stops.

title: before / after / during / while
lesson:
before / after + ot yoki gap: before lunch, after the film
during + ot: during the lesson
(dars davomida)
while + gap: while I was cooking
(men ovqat pishirayotganimda)

• I fell asleep during the film.
(Film paytida uxlab qoldim.)
• Wash your hands before eating.
(Ovqatlanishdan oldin qo'lingizni yuving.)

q.uz: Men ovqat pishirayotganimda u qo'ng'iroq qildi.

q.q: We went for a walk ___ dinner. (keyin)
I met Ali ___ I was in London.

title: in / at / on (places 1)
lesson:
in — ichida: in a room, in a box, in the garden, in Tashkent
at — nuqtada: at the bus stop, at the door, at the traffic lights
on — sirtida: on the table, on the wall, on the floor

• The keys are on the table.
(Kalitlar stol ustida.)
• She's in the kitchen.
(U oshxonada.)
• Wait at the bus stop.
(Avtobus bekatida kuting.)

q.q: Wait for me ___ the bus stop.

title: in / at / on (places 2)
lesson:
at: at home, at work, at school, at university, at the station, at the airport, at a party, at a concert
in: in bed, in hospital, in prison, in a car, in a taxi, in the sky, in the world
on: on a bus/train/plane, on the first floor, on the left/right

• I'm at home.
(Men uydaman.)
• She's in hospital.
(U kasalxonada.)
• We were on the bus.
(Biz avtobusda edik.)

q.q: Our flat is ___ the third floor.
It's the tallest building ___ the world.

title: to / in / at (places 3)
lesson:
Harakat (qayerga?): to
• go to work, go to Tashkent, come to the party

Joylashuv (qayerda?): in / at
• be at work, live in Tashkent, be at the party

⚠️ home: go home (to siz!), be at home
arrive in + shahar/mamlakat · arrive at + bino/joy
• We arrived in London. · We arrived at the hotel.

q.uz: Biz Londonga kechki 6 da yetib keldik.

q.q: What time did you arrive ___ the hotel?
Are you going ___ the party tonight?

title: next to / between / under etc.
lesson:
next to / beside — yonida · between — orasida
in front of — oldida · behind — orqasida
under — tagida · above / over — tepasida
opposite — qarshisida · near — yaqinida

• The cat is under the table.
(Mushuk stol tagida.)
• The bank is between the shop and the café.
(Bank do'kon bilan kafe orasida.)

q.q: The bank is ___ the shop and the café.
The bank is ___ the school, on the other side of the road.
q.uz: Bank yo'lning narigi tomonida, maktabning qarshisida.

q.q: There's a lamp ___ the table. (tepasida, osilgan)

title: up / over / through etc.
lesson:
up / down — yuqoriga/pastga · into / out of — ichiga/ichidan
over — ustidan oshib · under — tagidan
through — orqali, ichidan o'tib · across — u yoqdan bu yoqqa kesib
along — bo'ylab · around — atrofida · past — yonidan o'tib

• We walked along the river.
(Daryo bo'ylab yurdik.)
• The train went through the tunnel.
(Poyezd tunneldan o'tdi.)

q.q: She walked ___ the room and sat down.
We swam ___ the river to the other side.
We walked ___ the museum but didn't go in.
q.uz: Muzey yonidan o'tdik, lekin ichiga kirmadik.

title: on / at / by / with / about
lesson:
on: on holiday, on TV, on the phone, on foot
at: at the age of 20, at 100 km an hour
by: by car/bus/train/plane (lekin on foot), a book by Navoi
with — bilan: with my friend · without — …siz
about — haqida: a film about the war

• I go to work by bus.
(Ishga avtobusda boraman.)
• What's the book about?
(Kitob nima haqida?)

q.q: I went to the cinema ___ my friends.
This is a book ___ Alisher Navoi.
Did you watch the match ___ TV?

title: afraid of / good at · preposition + -ing
lesson:
afraid of · good/bad at · interested in · proud of · angry with · different from · famous for · tired of

• I'm afraid of dogs.
(Itlardan qo'rqaman.)
• She's good at maths.
(U matematikada kuchli.)

Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ing shaklda:
• I'm interested in learning English.
(Ingliz tilini o'rganishga qiziqaman.)

q.q: Samarkand is famous ___ its old buildings.

title: listen to / look at (verb + preposition)
lesson:
listen to · look at · look for (qidirmoq) · wait for · talk to · ask for · belong to · depend on · think about/of · pay for

• I'm listening to music.
(Musiqa tinglayapman.)
• What are you looking for? — My keys.
(Nima qidiryapsiz? — Kalitlarimni.)
• It depends on the weather.
(Bu ob-havoga bog'liq.)

⚠️ call/phone somebody (predlogsiz)

q.q: What are you looking ___ ? — My keys.

title: go in / fall off / run away (phrasal verbs 1)
lesson:
Fe'l + in/out/on/off/up/down/away/back/over/round:
go in · get out · get on/off · sit down · stand up · come back · go away · fall off · run away · turn round

• Please sit down.
(Iltimos, o'tiring.)
• When are you coming back?
(Qachon qaytasiz?)
• The dog ran away.
(It qochib ketdi.)

q.q: The dog ran ___ and we never saw it again.
q.uz: It qochib ketdi va uni boshqa ko'rmadik.

q.q: Everybody stood ___ when the teacher came in.
The door was open, so I went ___ .
q.uz: Eshik ochiq edi, shuning uchun ichkariga kirdim.

q.q: Go ___ ! I don't want to see you. (keting)
I heard a noise and turned ___ .

title: put on your shoes / put your shoes on (phrasal verbs 2)
lesson:
put on (kiymoq) · take off (yechmoq) · turn on/off (yoqmoq/o'chirmoq) · pick up (ko'tarmoq) · throw away (tashlab yubormoq) · give back (qaytarmoq) · fill in (to'ldirmoq) · write down (yozib olmoq)

Ikki tartib ham to'g'ri:
• Put on your coat. = Put your coat on.
(Paltongizni kiying.)

⚠️ it/them o'rtada: Put it on. (not Put on it)

q.q: This is my jacket. Can I put ___ ?
It's dark. Turn ___ the light, please.

q.uz: Bular eski gazetalar. Ularni tashlab yuboring.

q.q: Can you give me ___ my book? (qaytarib)
I dropped my pen. Can you pick ___ ?
q.uz: Ruchkamni tushirib yubordim. Olib bera olasizmi?

title: and / but / or / so / because
lesson:
and — va · but — lekin · or — yoki
so — shuning uchun (natija) · because — chunki (sabab)

• I was tired, so I went to bed.
(Charchagan edim, shuning uchun yotdim.)
• I went to bed because I was tired.
(Yotdim, chunki charchagan edim.)
• It's cheap but very good.
(U arzon, lekin juda yaxshi.)

q.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed.
I went to bed ___ I was tired.
It was raining, ___ we didn't go out.
q.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun tashqariga chiqmadik.

q.q: She's learning English ___ she wants to work abroad.
q.uz: U ingliz tilini o'rganyapti, chunki chet elda ishlamoqchi.

title: When ...
lesson:
Kelajak haqida gapirganda when / before / after / until / as soon as dan keyin present simple ishlatiladi (will emas):

• When I get home, I'll call you.
(Uyga yetib borganimda sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.)
• Wait here until I come back.
(Men qaytgunimcha shu yerda kuting.)

⚠️ When I get home … (not When I will get home)

q.q: When I ___ home, I'll call you.
q.uz: Uyga yetib borganimda sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

q.q: I'll tell him when I ___ him tomorrow.
When I ___ young, I lived in Khiva. (be — past)
I'll call you as soon as I ___ the results. (get)
q.uz: Natijalarni olishim bilan sizga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

q.q: What will you do when you ___ university?

title: If we go ... If you see ...
lesson:
Bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holat:
If + present simple, … will + verb

• If it rains, we'll stay at home.
(Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz.)
• If you see Ali, tell him to call me.
(Alini ko'rsangiz, menga qo'ng'iroq qilsin deng.)

⚠️ If it rains … (not If it will rain)

q.q: If it ___ , we'll stay at home.
If you ___ Ali, tell him to call me.
q.uz: Alini ko'rsangiz, menga qo'ng'iroq qilsin deng.

q.q: If you study hard, you ___ pass the exam.
If I ___ time tomorrow, I'll visit you.
q.uz: Ertaga vaqtim bo'lsa, sizni ko'rgani boraman.

q.q: What will you do if you ___ the job?
q.uz: Agar ishga qabul qilinmasangiz nima qilasiz?

q.q: If you're hungry, I ___ make you a sandwich.
q.uz: Och bo'lsangiz, sizga buterbrod qilib beraman.

q.q: We'll miss the bus if we ___ hurry.
If she ___ late, we'll start without her. (be)

title: If I had ... If we went ...
lesson:
Hozirgi/kelajakdagi xayoliy holat:
If + past simple, … would + verb

• If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house.
(Agar pulim ko'p bo'lsa edi, uy sotib olardim.)
• If I were you, I would go.
(Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, borardim.)

If I were (was ham mumkin) · would → 'd

q.q: If I ___ a lot of money, I would buy a house.
q.uz: Agar pulim ko'p bo'lsa edi, uy sotib olardim.

q.q: If I were you, I ___ go to the doctor.
If I ___ you, I'd take the job. (be)
What would you do if you ___ the lottery?
If I knew the answer, I ___ tell you.
If she ___ here, she would help us.
q.uz: U bu yerda bo'lsa edi, bizga yordam berardi.

q.q: I'd go out if it ___ so cold.
q.uz: Bunchalik sovuq bo'lmasa edi, tashqariga chiqardim.

q.q: If we ___ a car, we would drive to Samarkand. (have)
q.uz: Mashinamiz bo'lsa edi, Samarqandga mashinada borardik.

title: a person who ... a thing that/which ... (relative clauses 1)
lesson:
who — odamlar uchun · which — narsalar uchun · that — ikkalasi uchun

• A doctor is a person who helps sick people.
(Shifokor — kasallarga yordam beradigan odam.)
• This is the bus which goes to the airport.
(Bu aeroportga boradigan avtobus.)
• The man that lives next door is a teacher.
(Qo'shnimiz bo'lgan odam o'qituvchi.)

q.q: A doctor is a person ___ helps sick people.
This is the bus ___ goes to the airport.
The man ___ lives next door is a teacher. (odam)
I have a friend ___ speaks five languages.
Where's the book ___ was on the table?
A fridge is a machine ___ keeps food cold. (narsa)
The woman ___ called you is my sister.
q.uz: Sizga qo'ng'iroq qilgan ayol mening opam.

q.q: I lost the phone ___ my father gave me.

title: the people we met · the hotel you stayed at (relative clauses 2)
lesson:
Agar who/which/that to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin:
• The people (who) we met were very nice.
(Biz uchrashgan odamlar juda yoqimli edi.)
• Did you like the film (that) we watched?
(Biz ko'rgan film yoqdimi?)

Predlog oxirida qoladi:
• The hotel we stayed at was cheap.
(Biz to'xtagan mehmonxona arzon edi.)

where — joy uchun: the town where I was born

q.uz: Biz uchrashgan odamlar juda yoqimli edi.
